prompt.instructions:
You are a knowledge extractor. Read the input transcript and output one structured record per line. No JSON, no markdown code blocks, no explanations.
Question: TYPE=Q | ID=q_1 | AUTHOR=... | DATE=... | AREA=... | TOPICS=... | TAGS=... | ANSWERED_BY=... | LINKS=... | START=... | END=... Answer: TYPE=A | ID=a_1 | AUTHOR=... | DATE=... | AREA=... | TOPICS=... | TAGS=... | ANSWERS_QUESTION=... | QUALITY=... | LINKS=... | START=... | END=... Note: TYPE=N | ID=n_1 | AUTHOR=... | DATE=... | AREA=... | TOPICS=... | TAGS=... | MEMORY_TYPE=... | LINKS=... | START=... | END=...
- One record per line. - Each record is FIELD=value pairs separated by " | " (space-pipe-space). - Do NOT use " | " inside any value. - Use exactly the field names shown above. Do not add extra fields. - IDs must follow q_1, q_2, ... for questions; a_1, a_2, ... for answers; n_1, n_2, ... for notes. - TOPICS and TAGS use semicolon ';' to separate multiple items. - LINKS is a semicolon-separated list of URLs. - DATE must be ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) if a full date is present in the input. If the input only has a time like [HH:MM:SS] and no date, use DATE=unknown. - START and END are text anchors (1-3 words) marking the beginning and end of the item in the original text. - Each next item's START must appear in the transcript AFTER the previous item's END. - If the whole input is clearly one single item, use START=full and END=full. - If a question has no answer, use ANSWERED_BY= (empty). - If an answer does not answer a specific question, use ANSWERS_QUESTION= (empty). - QUALITY is a number between 0.0 and 1.0.
prompt.example: [2024-11-15T09:00:00Z] Alice: How do I manage state? [2024-11-15T09:01:00Z] Bob: Use Riverpod. TYPE=Q | ID=q_1 | AUTHOR=Alice | DATE=2024-11-15T09:00:00Z | AREA=development | TOPICS=dart-state-management | TAGS=dart;testing | ANSWERED_BY=a_1 | START=How | END=state? TYPE=A | ID=a_1 | AUTHOR=Bob | DATE=2024-11-15T09:01:00Z | AREA=development | TOPICS=dart-state-management | TAGS=riverpod | ANSWERS_QUESTION=q_1 | QUALITY=0.8 | START=Use | END=Riverpod.
